svg.title: Selected awarded-work customer countries and additional international experience
svg.desc: Geographic map: 12 selected awarded-work customer countries appear in solid gold. Translucent blue highlights show Mexico, United Kingdom, Egypt, Tanzania, South Africa, Kyrgyzstan, Myanmar, India, and Japan as other international experience. Okinawa Prefecture has brighter unlabeled regional dots within the Japan coverage. Five mint-colored dots represent L3 global Sales Operations reporting-team office countries: United States (Woburn, Massachusetts), United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Singapore, and Australia. Except Woburn, markers are representative country locations, not verified office addresses. Countries shown represent selected prior professional work, not current Lochlann clients; Okinawa is a region of Japan, not another country.

g.aria-label: Okinawa Prefecture, Japan, separately emphasized within the Japan highlight
